verses.text: For the choir director; according to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. My voice [rises] to God, and I will cry aloud; My voice [rises] to God, and He will hear me.
verses.textZh: （亞薩的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。）我要向神發聲呼求；我向　神發聲，他必留心聽我。

verses.text: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord; In the night my hand was stretched out without weariness; My soul refused to be comforted.
verses.textZh: 我在患難之日尋求主；我在夜間不住地舉手禱告；我的心不肯受安慰。

verses.text: [When] I remember God, then I am disturbed; [When] I sigh, then my spirit grows faint. Selah.
verses.textZh: 我想念神，就煩燥不安；我沉吟悲傷，心便發昏。（細拉）

verses.text: You have held my eyelids [open]; I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.textZh: 你叫我不能閉眼；我煩亂不安，甚至不能說話。

verses.text: I have considered the days of old, The years of long ago.
verses.textZh: 我追想古時之日，上古之年。

verses.text: I will remember my song in the night; I will meditate with my heart, And my spirit ponders:
verses.textZh: 我想起我夜間的歌曲，捫心自問；我心裡也仔細省察。

verses.text: Will the Lord reject forever? And will He never be favorable again?
verses.textZh: 難道主要永遠丟棄我，不再施恩麼？

verses.text: Has His lovingkindness ceased forever? Has [His] promise come to an end forever?
verses.textZh: 難道他的慈愛永遠窮盡，他的應許世世廢棄麼？

verses.text: Has God forgotten to be gracious, Or has He in anger withdrawn His compassion? Selah.
verses.textZh: 難道神忘記開恩，因發怒就止住他的慈悲麼？（細拉）

verses.text: Then I said, 'It is my grief, That the right hand of the Most High has changed.'
verses.textZh: 我便說：這是我的懦弱，但我要追念至高者顯出右手之年代。

verses.text: I shall remember the deeds of the LORD; Surely I will remember Your wonders of old.
verses.textZh: 我要提說耶和華所行的；我要記念你古時的奇事。

verses.text: I will meditate on all Your work And muse on Your deeds.
verses.textZh: 我也要思想你的經營，默念你的作為。

verses.text: Your way, O God, is holy; What god is great like our God?
verses.textZh: 神啊，你的作為是潔淨的；有何神大如神呢？

verses.text: You are the God who works wonders; You have made known Your strength among the peoples.
verses.textZh: 你是行奇事的神；你曾在列邦中彰顯你的能力。

verses.text: You have by Your power redeemed Your people, The sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.textZh: 你曾用你的膀臂贖了你的民，就是雅各和約瑟的子孫。（細拉）

verses.text: The waters saw You, O God; The waters saw You, they were in anguish; The deeps also trembled.
verses.textZh: 神啊，諸水見你，一見就都驚惶；深淵也都戰抖。

verses.text: The clouds poured out water; The skies gave forth a sound; Your arrows flashed here and there.
verses.textZh: 雲中倒出水來；天空發出響聲；你的箭也飛行四方。

verses.text: The sound of Your thunder was in the whirlwind; The lightnings lit up the world; The earth trembled and shook.
verses.textZh: 你的雷聲在旋風中；電光照亮世界；大地戰抖震動。

verses.text: Your way was in the sea And Your paths in the mighty waters, And Your footprints may not be known.
verses.textZh: 你的道在海中；你的路在大水中；你的腳蹤無人知道。

verses.text: You led Your people like a flock By the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.textZh: 你曾藉摩西和亞倫的手引導你的百姓，好像羊群一般。
